_comment: Rival driver radio. Keyed as rival_<PERSONA>_<event>.
Slots: {drv} the rival speaking, {oth} the other driver, {pos} position.
Personas: HOTHEAD COCKY VETERAN DRAMATIC JOKER ROOKIE VILLAIN.
Events: overtaken (you passed them), caught (they passed you),
praise (a good scrap), frustrated (bad race), pumped (good race).
Kept SHORT — this is a driver on the limit with one hand on the wheel,
not a press conference. Mild language only; the archetypes carry the
rival_HOTHEAD_overtaken: Oh, come ON! Where did he come from?!
That's dirty! He barged straight into me!
Are you kidding me? He didn't even brake!
He can't do that! Tell them he can't do that!
rival_HOTHEAD_caught: Out of my way — got him!
That's what happens when you hold me up!
Finally. He was holding the whole train up.
rival_HOTHEAD_blocked: Blue flags! Where are the blue flags?!
I'm losing a second a lap behind this!
rival_HOTHEAD_incident: No no no! I've lost it!
Damn it! That's my race gone!
rival_HOTHEAD_frustrated: I've got nothing. Nothing at all.
We've got this completely wrong today.
rival_COCKY_overtaken: Cute. I'll have that back next lap.
Lucky move. He won't keep it.
Enjoy the view while it lasts.
Oh, brave. Let's see how that works out.
rival_COCKY_caught: Thanks for the room. Not that he had a choice.
rival_COCKY_pumped: The car's perfect. I could do this all day.
We're quicker than everyone. Just say the word.
rival_COCKY_blocked: He's going to have to move sooner or later.
I'll wait. He'll make a mistake.
rival_COCKY_incident: Alright, that was my fault. It happens.
Got that one wrong. Won't happen twice.
rival_VETERAN_overtaken: Alright, he's through. Long race yet.
He committed to that. Fair enough.
Fine. We'll get it back when it counts.
rival_VETERAN_caught: Position gained. Let's look after these tyres.
rival_VETERAN_blocked: I'll bide my time behind this one.
No sense forcing it. He'll come to me.
Patience. There's a long way to go.
rival_VETERAN_incident: Got a bit greedy there. Carrying on.
rival_VETERAN_praise: He raced me fair. I'll take that.
rival_DRAMATIC_overtaken: My whole race — gone, just like that!
I don't believe it! Where did he come from?!
rival_DRAMATIC_caught: Got him! What a move, what a move!
In the name of everything — I'm through!
rival_DRAMATIC_incident: It's over! My race is over!
rival_DRAMATIC_frustrated: Everything is against us today. Everything.
Why does this always happen to me?
rival_DRAMATIC_pumped: The car is ALIVE! Let's go!
I can feel it! We're on for something here!
rival_JOKER_overtaken: Sure, just help yourself to my position.
Cool. Cool cool cool. Totally fine.
I was saving that place for someone nicer.
rival_JOKER_caught: Ta very much. Lovely of him.
One down. Only about fifteen to go.

rival_JOKER_blocked.t: I'm getting to know this rear wing very well.
I'm getting to know this gearbox very well.

rival_JOKER_blocked: Should I send him a postcard, or?
We're basically married at this point.
rival_JOKER_incident: Ten out of ten from the judges.
I meant to do that. Obviously.
rival_JOKER_frustrated: Remind me why I do this again?
rival_ROOKIE_overtaken: Ah, he got me. Sorry team, sorry.
Was I meant to defend that? Damn.
Lost a place. I'll do better.
rival_ROOKIE_caught: I got him! Did you see that?!
That's a pass! An actual pass!
Okay okay, calm. But I got him!
rival_ROOKIE_incident: I've messed up. I'm so sorry.
That was all my fault. Apologies.
rival_ROOKIE_blocked: Do I go round the outside here? Advice?
I don't want to do anything stupid.
rival_ROOKIE_pumped: This is amazing. Best day of my life.
I'm actually keeping up with them!
rival_VILLAIN_overtaken: He'll regret that. Mark my words.
Fine. We do this the hard way, then.
rival_VILLAIN_caught: He was never going to hold me.
Out of the way. Where he belongs.
rival_VILLAIN_blocked: He's in my way. That's a poor decision.
Last warning. Then I move him.
rival_VILLAIN_frustrated: Somebody has cost me this race.
This is not finished. Not remotely.
rival_ANY_damage: The car's not right after that contact.

rival_ANY_damage.t: Front wing's gone, I think. It's pulling badly.
The nose took a hit. It's pulling badly.

rival_ANY_pit: In the pits, in the pits.
